common.genericError: That didn't work. Check the connection to the server and try again.
common.connectionErrorBody: Synclet couldn't check your session because the server isn't responding. Make sure the server is running, then try again.

auth.setupHint: Create the administrator account. The username is also the folder name in the data directory.
auth.usernameInvalid: This name isn't allowed as a folder name. It can't start with a dot or contain characters like / \ : * ?.
auth.usernameTaken: That username or email is already in use.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
auth.setupDone: Synclet is already set up. Sign in with your account.
auth.selfHosted: Self-hosted. Your files stay on your server.

shell.notFoundBody: There's nothing at this address. The link may be cut off or the folder may have moved.

empty.title: This folder is empty
empty.body: Drag files here or upload them. Everything you add is stored as a regular file on your server.

notFound.title: This folder doesn't exist
notFound.body: It may have been moved or deleted.

drop.title: Drop to upload
drop.foldersUnsupported: Folders can't be uploaded by drag and drop yet. Drag the files inside them here instead.

moveDialog.title: Move “{{name}}”
moveDialog.description: Choose the folder to move it to.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.fileBody: The file moves to the trash and disappears from all connected devices.
deleteDialog.folderBody: The folder and everything in it move to the trash and disappear from all connected devices.

nameErrors.forbidden_char: Names can't contain any of these characters: < > : " / \ | ? *
nameErrors.trailing: Names can't end with a dot or a space.
nameErrors.reserved: This name is reserved on Windows.
nameErrors.ignored: This name is reserved for system files and wouldn't sync.

errors.name_conflict: Something with this name already exists here.
errors.invalid_move: A folder can't be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
errors.not_found: This item doesn't exist anymore. The view has been refreshed.
errors.conflict: The item changed in the meantime. Try again.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than the server allows.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

preview.truncated: Only the beginning of this file is shown. Download it to see everything.

none.title: No preview available
none.body: Download the file to open it in an app that can read it.
none.failed: The preview couldn't be loaded. Download the file to open it in an app.
